/obj/item/bombcore.name: bomb payload
/obj/item/bombcore.note: Does nothing until it detonates: a blast with radii 3 (heavy), 9 (medium), 17 (light) and 17 (flame). It detonates when it is hit by an explosion or burns up, which can chain from other blasts, or when a bomb shell triggers it; being destroyed by other damage doesn't set it off.
/obj/item/bombcore.reason: Bomb core with 3 devastation, 9 heavy, 17 light. Any blast or fire sets it off. One ruin has it.

/obj/item/bombcore/chemical.name: chemical payload
/obj/item/bombcore/chemical.note: Not an explosion: it mixes the chemicals in its loaded beaker or bottle (1 by default; more if crafted with larger casings or matter bins) with its own reagents, heats them 50 K, reacts them and spreads whatever is left over a radius of 5. If crafted with advanced release grenades it also pulses 50 units per grenade each second, but that branch has no return, so the first detonation still splashes everything left.
/obj/item/bombcore/chemical.reason: Spreads a loaded chemical mix over 5 tiles, or arms a chemical missile. Uses up a C-4 charge and two casings, and is only as strong as the chemist.

/obj/item/bombcore/dimensional.name: multi-dimensional payload
/obj/item/bombcore/dimensional.note: Deals no damage. When it detonates it converts the floors and walls (not space or indestructible ones) in a radius into one chosen dimension theme, or a random theme per tile if none was set, and swaps chairs, tables, airlocks and similar furniture for the theme's versions, spreading outward over time. The radius is 17 as spawned, or 13 when crafted, plus 1 per large or advanced release grenade and -2 or +4 for low or high quality gibtonite.
/obj/item/bombcore/dimensional.reason: No damage, but turns the floors, walls and doors within 13 tiles into another material, hull included, plasma walls among them. The black market lists one for 8,000 to 10,000 cr at 15% odds, or a dimensional anomaly core and gibtonite make it.

/obj/item/bombcore/miniature/pizza.name: pizza bomb
/obj/item/bombcore/miniature/pizza.reason: A syndicate minibomb hidden in a pizza box: 1 devastation, 2 heavy, 4 light. A trap found on maps, not bought.

/obj/item/bombcore/missile.name: standard missile warhead
/obj/item/bombcore/missile.reason: Standard ship missile warhead, 2 devastation, 3 heavy, 5 light, and it fits a backpack. An IED beside a loose one out-hits a minibomb for about 500 cr.

/obj/item/bombcore/missile/heavy.name: heavy missile warhead
/obj/item/bombcore/missile/heavy.reason: Heavy ship missile warhead, 3 devastation, 5 heavy, 7 light. A loose one goes off from any blast or fire, so it is also the biggest bomb in a shop, at 1,400 cr.

/obj/item/bombcore/missile/light.name: light missile warhead
/obj/item/bombcore/missile/light.reason: Light ship missile warhead, 1 devastation, 2 heavy, 3 light. Nearly a syndicate minibomb for under 200 cr; it just needs another blast or a fire to set it off.

/obj/item/bombcore/syndicate.name: Donk Co. Super-Stable Bomb Payload
/obj/item/bombcore/syndicate.note: A bomb core that ignores explosions entirely (its explosion handler does nothing), but its burn handler calls the parent, so it still detonates when it burns up; the shell triggers it electronically. Same blast as the plain core (3/9/17/17), and the XL version is 5/10/20/20.
/obj/item/bombcore/syndicate.reason: Bomb core with 3 devastation, 9 heavy, 17 light, the plain core's blast. Blasts and fire don't set it off. Comes out of the ticking bomb on one cargo shuttle loan.

/obj/item/bombcore/syndicate/large.name: Donk Co. Super-Stable Bomb Payload XL
/obj/item/bombcore/syndicate/large.note: A bomb core that ignores explosions entirely (its explosion handler does nothing), but its burn handler calls the parent, so it still detonates when it burns up; the shell triggers it electronically. Same blast as the plain core (3/9/17/17), and the XL version is 5/10/20/20.
/obj/item/bombcore/syndicate/large.reason: Ship self-destruct core: 5 devastation, 10 heavy, 20 light. Found in the bomb on one hull and two ruins.

/obj/item/grenade/barrier.name: barrier grenade
/obj/item/grenade/barrier.note: On detonation it builds one security barrier on its own tile, plus one on each side if those tiles are free (north and south in vertical mode, east and west in horizontal mode, none in single mode). Each barrier lets 20% of projectiles through; the mode cycles single, vertical, horizontal.
/obj/item/grenade/barrier.reason: One to three barricades that stop 80% of shots, on a 5 second fuse. Instant cover, no threat.

/obj/item/grenade/c4.name: C-4 charge
/obj/item/grenade/c4.reason: Stick-on charge with a timer you set. Opens the wall or door it is on, 3 light around it. The normal way through a hull.

/obj/item/grenade/c4/x4.name: X-4 charge
/obj/item/grenade/c4/x4.reason: Shaped charge with 5 heavy and 7 light through whatever it is stuck to. Far stronger than C-4. Ruins and pirate ships only.

/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade.name: chemical grenade
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade.reason: Plain casing for your own chemicals. Needs a chemist and is hard to come by.

/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/adv_relea.name: advanced release grenade
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/adv_relea.note: Releases its contents in repeated pulses instead of all at once: each time it goes off it draws 10 units (a multitool sets 5 to 100) in proportion from its beakers and splashes them over radius 3, then goes off again after the fuse time until the beakers are empty. The chemicals mix and react as in any chemical grenade; the casing adds 10 K of heat.
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/adv_relea.reason: Keeps pulsing its chemicals over 3 tiles until the beakers run dry. Holds a room with one mix, as strong as the chemist.

/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/cryo.name: cryo grenade
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/cryo.reason: Casing that chills its mix as it goes off. Needs a chemist.

/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/large.name: large grenade
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/large.note: A larger chemical grenade casing: splash radius 5, 25 K of ignition heat and a 1.1x reagent multiplier, and it accepts any cup, condiment or glass container and slime extracts (including bluespace beakers). If it holds a slime extract, the beaker contents are poured into the extract first so it activates before the splash.
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/large.reason: The best casing: splashes 5 tiles and takes bluespace beakers and slime extracts. As strong as the chemist who fills it.

/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/metalfoam.name: metal foam grenade
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/metalfoam.reason: Fills a breach with plain metal foam. Blocks the way as well as the hole.

/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/pyro.name: pyro grenade
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/pyro.reason: Casing that heats its mix as it goes off, so hot reactions fire inside it. Needs a chemist.

/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/smart_met.name: smart metal foam grenade
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/smart_met.reason: Fills a breach with metal foam. A cheap repair that can also wall off a corridor in a hurry.

/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/teargas.name: teargas grenade
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/teargas.reason: Pepper gas for clearing a room. A mask or internals beats it.

/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/tuberculo.name: Fungal tuberculosis grenade
/obj/item/grenade/chem_grenade/tuberculo.reason: Releases deadly fungal tuberculosis spores that can spread through a whole crew. One pirate ship has it.

/obj/item/grenade/clusterbuster/smoke.name: Ninja Vanish
/obj/item/grenade/clusterbuster/smoke.note: On detonation it scatters 4 to 8 pieces; each has a 35% chance of being a segment that later releases another 4 to 8 payloads, and the rest are live payload grenades that go off 1.5 to 6 seconds after landing. The payload depends on the variant (Ninja Vanish releases smoke grenades).
/obj/item/grenade/clusterbuster/smoke.reason: Scatters a swarm of smoke grenades across a room. A way out for one person, but rare.

/obj/item/grenade/empgrenade.name: classic EMP grenade
/obj/item/grenade/empgrenade.note: Sends out an EMP pulse with a heavy radius of 4 and a light radius of 10, then is used up. No damage by itself.
/obj/item/grenade/empgrenade.reason: Heavy EMP out to 4 tiles, light out to 10. Hits borgs, suits, energy guns and cyberware on both sides. No damage of its own.

/obj/item/grenade/firecracker.name: large firecracker
/obj/item/grenade/firecracker.note: Has to be lit with a fire source; it then goes off after 3 seconds (wirecutters shorten the fuse by 1 second each, and fire exposure sets it off at once) with a small explosion (light radius 2 only, no heavy or devastation).
/obj/item/grenade/firecracker.reason: Hand-lit, 2 light after 3 seconds. More toy than weapon.

/obj/item/grenade/flashbang.name: flashbang
/obj/item/grenade/flashbang.reason: Anyone within 7 tiles without eye and ear protection goes down for at least 6 seconds. Sunglasses take away most of it.

/obj/item/grenade/frag.name: frag grenade
/obj/item/grenade/frag.note: Detonates with a small explosion (heavy 1, light 3, flame 4) and fires 32 shrapnel shards outward in a ring 4 tiles out; each shard is a 14 damage edged round that can embed, dismember and ricochet twice. Someone standing or lying on the grenade soaks up part of the shrapnel.
/obj/item/grenade/frag.reason: 1 heavy, 3 light and 32 shards of 14 damage in a ring. Clears a room of soft targets, but will not open a hull.

/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/crystal_fo.name: crystal foam
/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/crystal_fo.note: Goes off into smart metal foam spreading through a radius of 7: space tiles it reaches become foam plating, and it hardens into foam walls only where a tile borders a different area, so hull breaches seal and the room stays open. / Base for the gas crystals: crushing one starts a 5 second fuse, it is fireproof, and the base type has no payload of its own, so the effect comes entirely from the subtype.
/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/crystal_fo.reason: Seals hull breaches over 7 tiles with foam plating and walls, and leaves the room open. A smart metal foam grenade that comes from a crystallizer.

/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/healium_cr.name: Healium crystal
/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/healium_cr.note: Replaces the air on every open tile within 7 tiles, walls don't block it, with normal air (22 oxygen, 82 nitrogen at 293 K). Any other gas there is gone, and vacuum tiles are filled. / Base for the gas crystals: crushing one starts a 5 second fuse, it is fireproof, and the base type has no payload of its own, so the effect comes entirely from the subtype.
/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/healium_cr.reason: Swaps the air within 7 tiles, walls or no walls, for clean breathable air. Fixes a gassed or airless room at once. From a crystallizer.

/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/nitrous_ox.name: N2O crystal
/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/nitrous_ox.note: Releases a small puff of nitrous oxide when it goes off: 10 moles at 273 K onto every open tile within 1 tile, then it is used up. No damage and no explosion. / Base for the gas crystals: crushing one starts a 5 second fuse, it is fireproof, and the base type has no payload of its own, so the effect comes entirely from the subtype.
/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/nitrous_ox.reason: A puff of sleeping gas around itself after a 5 second fuse. Internals stop it, and it thins fast in open rooms.

/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/proto_nitr.name: Proto Nitrate crystal
/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/proto_nitr.note: Adds nitrogen and oxygen at 273 K to every open tile in view within 5 tiles: 80 and 30 moles on the centre and adjacent tiles, divided by distance further out. It adds to the air already there and removes nothing. / Base for the gas crystals: crushing one starts a 5 second fuse, it is fireproof, and the base type has no payload of its own, so the effect comes entirely from the subtype.
/obj/item/grenade/gas_crystal/proto_nitr.reason: Adds breathable air within 5 tiles in view, most at the centre. Refills a room that lost its air, but leaves any bad gas there. From a crystallizer.

/obj/item/grenade/gluon.name: gluon frag grenade
/obj/item/grenade/gluon.note: Sends a radiation pulse out 4 tiles and turns every open floor within 4 tiles into slippery permafrost for 6 minutes (galoshes don't help); anyone on those floors takes 30 stamina damage and has body temperature lowered by 230.
/obj/item/grenade/gluon.reason: Radiation and 30 stamina out to 4 tiles, freezes anyone standing there and leaves the floor slippery for minutes.

/obj/item/grenade/iedcasing.name: improvised explosive
/obj/item/grenade/iedcasing.note: Goes off when its attached timer, proximity, signaler or similar assembly fires, with an explosion scaled by its power (the pre-built one has power 2.5: heavy 0, light 2, flame 2 to 4 and no shrapnel). Stuffed items change it: meat adds gibs, paper adds confetti, glass shards add that many shrapnel shards, and refined bluespace crystals teleport nearby mobs.
/obj/item/grenade/iedcasing.reason: Hand-built pipe bomb whose blast comes from its fuel. Welding fuel gives 2 light; nitroglycerin or TATP gives 2 heavy, 7 to 9 light and a wide fire, more reach than a frag. Anyone can build the casing, so the chemist is the gate.

/obj/item/grenade/iedcasing/spawned.name: improvised explosive
/obj/item/grenade/iedcasing/spawned.note: Goes off when its attached timer, proximity, signaler or similar assembly fires, with an explosion scaled by its power (the pre-built one has power 2.5: heavy 0, light 2, flame 2 to 4 and no shrapnel). Stuffed items change it: meat adds gibs, paper adds confetti, glass shards add that many shrapnel shards, and refined bluespace crystals teleport nearby mobs.
/obj/item/grenade/iedcasing/spawned.reason: Pipe, welding fuel and a timer: 2 light and some fire. Anyone can build it at round start. The hand-built route with better fuels goes much higher.

/obj/item/grenade/mirage.name: mirage grenade
/obj/item/grenade/mirage.note: On a 3 second fuse, makes a copy that looks like whoever armed it at the grenade's spot, for 15 seconds, with sparks. The copy doesn't move or attack and doesn't block movement; with nobody having armed it, only the sparks happen.
/obj/item/grenade/mirage.reason: A still copy of whoever armed it, for 15 seconds. Confuses players, wins no fights.

/obj/item/grenade/smokebomb.name: smoke grenade
/obj/item/grenade/smokebomb.note: Releases a size 4 cloud of opaque coughing smoke that lasts 16 seconds: anyone breathing it without internals drops everything they hold, takes 1 oxygen damage and coughs about once a second, and beams passing through lose half their damage. It also damages blob structures within 8 tiles.
/obj/item/grenade/smokebomb.reason: 16 seconds of thick smoke. Without internals you drop whatever you hold, about once a second, and beams lose half their damage inside.

/obj/item/grenade/spawnergrenade/spessca.name: carp delivery grenade
/obj/item/grenade/spawnergrenade/spessca.note: When it goes off it flashes every carbon that can see it and spawns its mob type scattered around (the carp delivery grenade spawns 5 ordinary carp, with no tie to the thrower).
/obj/item/grenade/spawnergrenade/spessca.reason: Five ordinary carp and a flash. They bite whoever is nearest, thrower included.

/obj/item/grenade/stingbang.name: stingbang
/obj/item/grenade/stingbang.note: Fires 40 rubber pellets in a ring (3 brute and 8 stamina each, 55% embed, ricochets up to 4 times) and flash-bangs anyone within 1 tile: a flash that gets through paralyzes for 1 second and knocks down for 10, and on the same tile it is also a 2 second paralysis, a 20 second knockdown, a deafening bang and 10 brute plus 10 burn. If it goes off in a hand, that hand is dismembered.
/obj/item/grenade/stingbang.reason: 40 rubber pellets in a ring, 3 brute and 8 stamina each, plus a flash at one tile. Clears a doorway.

/obj/item/grenade/syndieminibomb.name: syndicate minibomb
/obj/item/grenade/syndieminibomb.note: A single explosion at its location with devastation 1, heavy 2, light 4 and flame 2. The HE Grenade variant inherits the devastation of 1 and is 1/2/3/3, and despite its description it has no shrapnel set.
/obj/item/grenade/syndieminibomb.reason: Thrown bomb with 1 devastation, 2 heavy, 4 light. Breaks walls and gibs whoever it lands on. The strongest grenade on sale.

/obj/item/grenade/syndieminibomb/concuss.name: HE Grenade
/obj/item/grenade/syndieminibomb/concuss.note: A single explosion at its location with devastation 1, heavy 2, light 4 and flame 2. The HE Grenade variant inherits the devastation of 1 and is 1/2/3/3, and despite its description it has no shrapnel set.
/obj/item/grenade/syndieminibomb/concuss.reason: A minibomb with slightly less light blast, and more fire. No shrapnel despite the label. One ruin has it.

/obj/item/transfer_valve.name: tank transfer valve
/obj/item/transfer_valve.note: Holds two gas tanks and an assembly; opening the valve (by hand, by the attached assembly firing, or by deep-frying it) pours both tanks into one with their volumes combined, and closing it splits them again. It deals no damage itself; any reaction or rupture comes from what is in the tanks.
/obj/item/transfer_valve.reason: Two tanks and a valve: the way to build a bomb up to the cap of 5 devastation, 10 heavy, 20 light. Takes gas know-how, then deletes a ship.

method: Rated by what the blast or effect does to a crew or a hull: devastation and heavy rings that open ships are red, room-clearers and stuns are yellow, utility is green. Casings and kits rate as what they let a competent crew make, and ship warheads are rated for what a loose one does in a player's hands.
